# Pull Request Template

## 📋 Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

**Problem Solved:**
[Describe the problem being solved here]

**Solution Implemented:**
[Describe your solution and changes here]

## 🛠 Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code style/refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Telemetry or Analytics event update

## 🧪 Testing & Verification
Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.

- [ ] Unit Tests Passed (Vitest)
- [ ] Integration Tests Passed
- [ ] End-to-End Tests Passed (Playwright)
- [ ] Responsive UI verified on Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile views.
- [ ] Light/Dark themes verified.

## 🔐 Security & RLS Review
- [ ] All inputs validated via Zod schemas.
- [ ] Row Level Security (RLS) policies reviewed. No horizontal data leak.
- [ ] No hardcoded passwords, keys, or secrets.
- [ ] All environment variables configured securely.

## 📷 Screenshots / Demos (If Applicable)
[Attach images or links to videos here]
